description: Defines the AttachmentViewHolder class for managing attachment item views in a RecyclerView, handling different attachment types (image, video, audio, generic) and user interactions.

classes.name: AttachmentViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for displaying attachments in a RecyclerView, supporting image, video, audio, and generic types, with interaction handling.

methods.name: AttachmentViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with context, binding, listener, and preview mode.

methods.name: loadThumbnail
methods.description: Loads a thumbnail image into an ImageView with size adjustments based on preview mode.

methods.name: setIndicator
methods.description: Sets an indicator icon for attachment type.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description text and visibility.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an Attachment object to the view, displaying appropriate content based on attachment type.

methods.name: showMoreAttachmentsIndicator
methods.description: Displays an indicator for additional attachments.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Updates the view based on payloads, such as description changes.
